subject: design/workbench-ui-v1
statement: The entry is the released `workbench-ui` Go binary, invoked in an installed repo through `pyxis exec workbench-ui -- [--repo <path>] [--no-open]` and directly in source mode. No shell launcher or secondary runtime is added. Arguments parse fail-closed: any flag-like positional or unknown flag is a usage refusal before any action (incident I3's lesson, applied from birth).
